title: Add capability contract interfaces for HTTP and data persistence
body:
Implements abstract capability contracts (`IHttpServer`, `IDataEngine`) to decouple plugins from concrete HTTP framework and data layer implementations, completing the microkernel architecture foundation.

## Changes

### New Interfaces

**`src/interfaces/http-server.ts`**
- `IHttpServer`: Abstract HTTP routing (get, post, put, delete, patch, use, listen)
- `IHttpRequest` / `IHttpResponse`: Generic request/response types
- Enables plugins to work with Express, Fastify, Hono, or any HTTP framework

**`src/interfaces/data-engine.ts`**
- `IDataEngine`: Abstract CRUD operations (insert, find, update, delete)
- `QueryOptions`: Flexible query filters, sorting, pagination
- Enables plugins to work with ObjectQL, Prisma, TypeORM, or any data layer

### Usage Example

```typescript
class ApiPlugin implements Plugin {
  name = 'api';
  dependencies = ['http-server', 'data-engine'];
  
  async start(ctx: PluginContext) {
    const server = ctx.getService<IHttpServer>('http-server');
    const db = ctx.getService<IDataEngine>('data-engine');
    
    // Framework-agnostic - works with any HTTP/data implementation
    server.post('/api/users', async (req, res) => {
      const user = await db.insert('user', req.body);
      res.status(201).json(user);
    });
  }
}
```

### Supporting Files

- `src/test-interfaces.ts`: Mock implementations demonstrating both interfaces
- `src/index.ts`: Export new interfaces from package
- `README.md`: API documentation with code examples

## Design Notes

Follows Dependency Inversion Principle: plugins depend on stable abstractions rather than volatile concrete implementations. Concrete adapters (Hono, Express, ObjectQL) implement these interfaces and register themselves via the service registry.

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> 全局设定 (System Context)
> 
> 在开始之前，先给 AI 输入这段上下文，确立架构基调：
> 
> Context: I am building "ObjectStack", an enterprise-grade low-code platform. Architecture: Microkernel Architecture (Plugin-based). Package Name: @objectstack/core (The runtime kernel). Design Philosophy: The Core only defines Interfaces (Contracts) and manages the Lifecycle. Actual business logic (like HTTP Servers or Database connections) must be implemented in Plugins. Tech Stack: TypeScript, Node.js.
> 
> 第一步：构建内核与基础类型 (The Kernel & Types)
> 
> 目标：建立没有任何业务逻辑的纯净运行时。
> 
> 📋 Prompt 1
> 
> Task: Create the foundation for @objectstack/core.
> 
> Requirements:
> 
> Define Interfaces (src/types.ts):
> 
> Plugin: Must have name, version?, dependencies? (string[]), and lifecycle methods init(ctx) and start(ctx).
> 
> PluginContext: The interface for the object passed to plugins. It must support:
> 
> registerService(name: string, instance: any): To register a capability.
> 
> getService<T>(name: string): To retrieve a capability (throw error if not found).
> 
> hook(event: string, handler: Function) and trigger(event: string, data: any).
> 
> Implement Kernel (src/kernel.ts):
> 
> Create class ObjectKernel.
> 
> Implement use(plugin) to add plugins to a registry.
> 
> Implement bootstrap():
> 
> Phase 1: Validate dependencies (ensure required plugins are present).
> 
> Phase 2: Call init() on all plugins sequentially.
> 
> Phase 3: Call start() on all plugins.
> 
> Constraint: Keep this file generic. Do NOT import Express, Database libraries, or any business logic here.
> 
> 第二步：定义核心能力契约 (The Contracts)
> 
> 目标：在 Core 中制定“法律”，规定 HTTP 服务和数据引擎应该长什么样，但不写具体实现。
> 
> 📋 Prompt 2
> 
> Task: Define the standard capabilities contracts in @objectstack/core.
> 
> Context: We need standard interfaces so plugins can interact without knowing the underlying implementation (Dependency Inversion).
> 
> Requirements:
> 
> Create src/interfaces/http-server.ts:
> 
> Define interface IHttpServer.
> 
> It should define generic methods for routing: get(path, handler), post(path, handler), use(path, handler).
> 
> It should define listen(port).
> 
> Note: Do not use Express types directly here, keep it abstract if possible, or use generic Request/Response types.
> 
> Create src/interfaces/data-engine.ts:
> 
> Define interface IDataEngine.
> 
> Methods:
> 
> insert(objectName: string, data: any): Promise<any>
> 
> find(objectName: string, query?: any): Promise<any[]>
> 
> update(objectName: string, id: any, data: any): Promise<any>
> 
> delete(objectName: string, id: any): Promise<boolean>
> 
> Constraint: Only write TypeScript interface definitions. No class implementations yet.


</details>
